text:
[Council File 26-1333]
Motion (Padilla – Blumenfield) relative to the resources needed to implement a comprehensive citywide program for planting and maintaining trees in vacant tree wells that factors in the unique watering needs of different species throughout the City.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For:
Sylmar Neighborhood Council
summary: Council asks what resources a citywide program would need to plant and maintain trees in vacant tree wells, accounting for different species' watering needs.

details.action: report on resources needed for tree planting and maintenance program

outcome.text: Public Works Committee approved item(s) (Oct 13, 2026); Council action final
